preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except thiosulfate and sodium sulfide), adjust
    pH to 6.0, boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and
    20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Dispense under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type
    tubes or serum vials to 30% of their volume and autoclave. Add sodium thiosulfate
    from an anoxic stock solution prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration.
    Reduce medium with a sterile, neutralized solution of sodium sulfide prepared
    under 100% N2 gas . Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.0, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: After inoculation pressurize cultivation vessels to   2 bar overpressure
    using sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture.
- step_number: 3
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: The sulfide solution is prepared in a 250 ml screw-capped bottle with
    a butyl rubber septum and a magnetic stirrer. The solution is bubbled with nitrogen
    gas, closed and autoclaved for 15 min. at 121°C. After cooling to room temperature
    the pH is adjusted to about 7.0 by adding of sterile 2 M H2SO4 drop-wise with
    a syringe without opening the bottle.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except thiosulfate and sodium sulfide), adjust
    pH to 6.0, boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and
    20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Dispense under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type
    tubes or serum vials to 30% of their volume and autoclave. Add sodium thiosulfate
    from an anoxic stock solution prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration.
    Reduce medium with a sterile, neutralized solution of sodium sulfide prepared
    under 100% N2 gas . Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.0, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: After inoculation pressurize cultivation vessels to   2 bar overpressure
    using sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture.
applications:
- Microbial cultivation

old.description: Dissolve ingredients (except thiosulfate and sodium sulfide), adjust pH to 6.0, boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Dispense under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials to 30% of their volume and autoclave. Add sodium thiosulfate from an anoxic stock solution prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration. Reduce medium with a sterile, neutralized solution of sodium sulfide prepared under 100% N2 gas . Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.0, if necessary.
After inoculation pressurize cultivation vessels to   2 bar overpressure using sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture.

The sulfide solution is prepared in a 250 ml screw-capped bottle with a butyl rubber septum and a magnetic stirrer. The solution is bubbled with nitrogen gas, closed and autoclaved for 15 min. at 121°C. After cooling to room temperature the pH is adjusted to about 7.0 by adding of sterile 2 M H2SO4 drop-wise with a syringe without opening the bottle.

step_number: 1 action: AUTOCLAVE description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins and sulfide), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which contain already the appropriate amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume to allow for a large head space. Autoclave at a temperature of 110°C for 20 min! Add vitamins and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and carbonate from a sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Vitamins are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.0 - 6.5, if necessary. - step_number: 2 action: MIX description: After inoculation use 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. - step_number: 3 action: ADJUST_PH description: First dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid and adjust pH to 6.5 with KOH, then add minerals. preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins and sulfide),
    boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2
    gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere
    into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which contain already the appropriate
    amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume to allow for a large head space.
    Autoclave at a temperature of <b>110°C</b> for 20 min! Add vitamins and sulfide
    from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and
    carbonate from a sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2
    gas mixture. Vitamins are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete
    medium to 6.0 - 6.5, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: After inoculation use 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20%
    CO2 gas mixture.

old.description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins and sulfide), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which contain already the appropriate amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume to allow for a large head space. Autoclave at a temperature of 110°C for 20 min! Add vitamins and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and carbonate from a sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Vitamins are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.0 - 6.5, if necessary.
After inoculation use 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture.
First dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid and adjust pH to 6.5 with KOH, then add minerals. Adjust final to pH 7.0 with KOH.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins and sulfide),
    boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2
    gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere
    into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which contain already the appropriate
    amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume to allow for a large head space.
    Autoclave at a temperature of <b>110°C</b> for 20 min! Add vitamins and sulfide
    from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and
    carbonate from a sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2
    gas mixture. Vitamins are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete
    medium to 6.0 - 6.5, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: After inoculation add 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20%
    CO2 gas mixture.

old.description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins and sulfide), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which contain already the appropriate amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume to allow for a large head space. Autoclave at a temperature of 110°C for 20 min! Add vitamins and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and carbonate from a sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Vitamins are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.0 - 6.5, if necessary.
After inoculation add 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture.
First dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid and adjust pH to 6.5 with KOH, then add minerals. Adjust final to pH 7.0 with KOH.

step_number: 1 action: AUTOCLAVE description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins, growth-stimulating factors and Na-dithionite), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which contain already the appropriate amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume to allow for a large head space. Autoclave at a temperature of 110°C for 20 min! Add vitamins and growth-stimulating factors from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas and carbonate and Na-dithionite from sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Vitamins and Na-dithionite are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.0, if necessary. - step_number: 2 action: MIX description: After inoculation use 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. - step_number: 3 action: AUTOCLAVE description: Dissolve ingredients, adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH, then autoclave under 100% N2 gas. - step_number: 4 action: DISSOLVE description: First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml. - step_number: 5 action: FILTER_STERILIZE description: Add 1 N NaOH to distilled water and make the solution anoxic by sparging with 100% N2 gas. Then dissolve the Na-dithionite and filter-sterilize the solution into anoxic Hungate tubes. The final pH of the solution should be between 9 and 10. Store the prepared solution in a dark and cool place. preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins, growth-stimulating
    factors and Na-dithionite), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature
    under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80%
    H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which
    contain already the appropriate amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume
    to allow for a large head space. Autoclave at a temperature of <b>110°C</b> for
    20 min! Add vitamins and growth-stimulating factors from sterile anoxic stock
    solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas and carbonate and Na-dithionite from sterile
    anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Vitamins
    and Na-dithionite are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium
    to 6.0, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: After inoculation use 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20%
    CO2 gas mixture.
applications:
- Microbial cultivation

old.description: Dissolve ingredients (except sulfur, carbonate, vitamins, growth-stimulating factors and Na-dithionite), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials which contain already the appropriate amount of sulfur, only to 30% of their volume to allow for a large head space. Autoclave at a temperature of 110°C for 20 min! Add vitamins and growth-stimulating factors from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas and carbonate and Na-dithionite from sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Vitamins and Na-dithionite are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.0, if necessary.
After inoculation use 1 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture.
Dissolve ingredients, adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH, then autoclave under 100% N2 gas.
First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, yeast extract, vitamins, growth-stimulating
    factors and Na-dithionite), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature
    under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense medium
    under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials to 30%
    of their volume and autoclave. Add yeast extract, vitamins, and growth-stimulating
    factors from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere
    and carbonate and Na-dithionite  from sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under
    80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Vitamins and Na-dithionite are sterilized by filtration.
    Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.5, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: After inoculation use 2 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20%
    CO2 gas mixture.
- step_number: 3
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve
    the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients, adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH, then autoclave under
    100% N2 gas.
- step_number: 5
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Add 1 N NaOH to distilled water and make the solution anoxic by sparging
    with 100% N2 gas. Then dissolve the Na-dithionite and filter-sterilize the solution
    into anoxic Hungate tubes. The final pH of the solution should be between 9 and
    10. Store the prepared solution in a dark and cool place. Prepare only small amounts
    of stock solution, as Na-dithionite decomposes rapidly.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, yeast extract, vitamins, growth-stimulating
    factors and Na-dithionite), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature
    under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense medium
    under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials to 30%
    of their volume and autoclave. Add yeast extract, vitamins, and growth-stimulating
    factors from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere
    and carbonate and Na-dithionite  from sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under
    80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Vitamins and Na-dithionite are sterilized by filtration.
    Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.5, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: After inoculation use 2 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20%
    CO2 gas mixture.
applications:
- Microbial cultivation

    Additional exact excerpt: "Add 1 N NaOH to distilled water and make the solution anoxic by sparging with 100% N2 gas. Then dissolve the Na-dithionite and filter-sterilize the solution into anoxic Hungate tubes. The final pH of the solution should be between 9 and 10. Store the prepared solution in a dark and cool place. Prepare only small amounts of stock solution, as Na-dithionite decomposes rapidly."

    Additional exact excerpt: "Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, yeast extract, vitamins, growth-stimulating factors and Na-dithionite), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense medium under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials to 30% of their volume and autoclave. Add yeast extract, vitamins, and growth-stimulating factors from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and carbonate and Na-dithionite  from sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Vitamins and Na-dithionite are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.5, if necessary."

old.description: Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, yeast extract, vitamins, growth-stimulating factors and Na-dithionite), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Adjust pH to 6.0 and dispense medium under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials to 30% of their volume and autoclave. Add yeast extract, vitamins, and growth-stimulating factors from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and carbonate and Na-dithionite  from sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Vitamins and Na-dithionite are sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of the complete medium to 6.5, if necessary.
After inoculation use 2 bar overpressure of sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture.
First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.
Dissolve ingredients, adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH, then autoclave under 100% N2 gas.
